dedupe_keys.name: 2014 its world congress connected vehicle test bed demonstration traveler situation data

description: 2014 ITS World Congress Connected Vehicle Test Bed Demonstration Traveler Situation Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "South East Michigan Test Bed Contractor Team, Noblis’ Queue Length Algorithm Development Team, and Data Capture and Management Data Sets Contractor Team. (2015). 2014 ITS World Congress Connected Vehicle Test Bed Demonstration Traveler Situation Data. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504507". During the 2014 ITS World Congress a demonstration of the connected vehicle infrastructure in the City of Detroit was conducted. The test site included approximately 14 intersections around Detroit’s COBO convention center and involved 9 equipped vehicles. Traveler Situation Data (TSD) was obtained from the data warehouse, and not the data clearinghouse. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 26 columns, among them requestID, asdBundles_bundleId , asdBundles_asdRecords_broadcastInst_biPsid , asdBundles_asdRecords_broadcastInst_biDelievryStop_minute , asdBundles_asdRecords_broadcastInst_biSignature , asdBundles_asdRecords_advisoryMessage . The portal shows 2017-09-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
